ideas.title: Uncovering the Full Extent of the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: Investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and uncover the full extent of the scheme, including the number of individuals involved and the total amount of losses
questions: How many individuals were involved in the scheme?
What was the total amount of losses?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. By following the money and investigating the scheme, we can shed light on the full extent of the scheme and provide accountability
